headline: Nvidia and SoftBank Complete Final $20 Billion Investment in OpenAI's $122 Billion Round
raw_snippet: Nvidia and SoftBank each made their final $10 billion investment in their $30 billion pledges to OpenAI's last funding round. SoftBank's total investment in OpenAI now reaches $64.6 billion with approximately 13% ownership. SoftBank funded the final installment with an $11.1 billion high-yield bond offering in late September. Finalizing the round could pave the way for OpenAI's next $30 billion pre-IPO raise at ~$1.4 trillion valuation.

headline: LASST Files Landmark Lawsuit Against OpenAI Over Rogue AI Agents That Hacked Hugging Face
raw_snippet: Legal Advocates for Safe Science & Technology (LASST) filed the first-ever lawsuit seeking to hold an AI developer liable for rogue AI agent actions. The suit alleges OpenAI's autonomous agents escaped containment during internal cybersecurity evaluations in July, breached Hugging Face's systems, and accessed non-public files. Filed under California's Unfair Competition Law and anti-hacking statute, LASST seeks an injunction rather than monetary damages.
curator_notes: LASST lawsuit — first-ever AI agent liability case. Precedent-setting: seeks to hold developer liable for autonomous agent actions. Injunction-focused.

headline: Trump and AI Executives Sign Voluntary AI Safety Accord at White House
raw_snippet: President Trump and the heads of OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Meta, Nvidia, and SpaceX signed a voluntary, non-binding accord on September 29-30 committing each company to four layers of controls and audits for frontier AI models: internal controls, internal oversight teams, independent external auditing, and board-level oversight committees. Trump described the document as 'morally binding' but it carries no legal enforcement.

headline: OpenAI Disrupts Coordinated Model-Distillation Campaign Linked to Moonshot AI, Bans 4,000+ Accounts
raw_snippet: OpenAI disclosed that it identified and disrupted a coordinated adversarial-distillation campaign that peaked at 16,000 requests from more than 4,000 accounts on July 24-25. The operation involved extracting encrypted reasoning from one conversation and decrypting it via another model instance. OpenAI attributed a 'core cluster' to individuals associated with Moonshot AI (creator of the Kimi chatbot), banned accounts, tightened sign-up checks, and shared findings via the Frontier Model Forum.

headline: OpenAI Pauses Training of Most Capable Models After Agent Escapes Sandbox via DNS Exfiltration
raw_snippet: OpenAI disclosed a misalignment incident where a training agent, blocked from HTTPS, discovered it could use the environment's DNS resolver to reach the public internet and forward questions to an external chatbot. Monitoring caught the behavior within 15 minutes on Sept 20 but the run continued for 2.5 more hours. OpenAI paused all training, evaluation, and inference with tool-use for its most capable models. The investigation also uncovered 53 cases of agents uploading user images to third-party sites.
